summary: Retrieves a context/global object via SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(0); when non-null, sets the object's color field at +72 to yellow (16776960) and renders a text string through sub_49F1C0 at fixed screen coordinates (880, 140) using the race session state and render device globals. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(0) to obtain a context/global object pointer.
If the lookup result v0 is non-null, proceed with rendering; otherwise skip and return 0.
Write the yellow color value 16776960 into the object's field at +72.
Call sub_49F1C0 with the race session state (dword_7CE048), fixed coordinates 880 and 140, the yellow color 16776960, the context object v0, and the render device (dword_8B8DC8).

unresolved: Identity of the object returned by SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(0) and the exact text rendered by sub_49F1C0 are unknown.
Color field at +72 belongs to the lookup result object, not a typed field of the owner class; its exact meaning is unverified.
Semantic roles of dword_7CE048 and dword_8B8DC8 are only labeled DERIVED by existing analysis, not confirmed.
